package.name: nidar_platform
package.description: Vehicle platform glue: relays FAST-LIO odometry into PX4's EKF2 as external vision (relay_odometry.py) and builds the PX4 SITL target for the airframe (build_px4.sh). The vendored PX4 tree itself stays at simulation/PX4-Autopilot-v1.14.3; this package points at it.
